description: OAuth authorization redirect appends issued code to body.redirectUri; user-influenced redirect target on an auth-bearing flow.
demotionReason: redirectUri validated against the registered client's redirectUris via isOriginAllowed allow-list (line 63) before redirect; non-allowlisted URIs rejected with BadRequestException.

description: OAuth2 exception filter performs HTTP 303 redirect to exception.redirectUrl during error handling.
demotionReason: redirectUrl is server-constructed inside the OAuth2 redirect exception filter, not taken directly from attacker input.

description: Server-side redirect on an app page route invoked during request handling.
demotionReason: Redirect destination is a hardcoded static internal path ("/auth/login"); no user input flows into the redirect target.

description: Login redirect interpolates callbackUrl into an internal /auth/login query string.
demotionReason: callbackUrl is confined to an internal path template and consumed by next-auth callback handling, which validates callback origins.

description: Outbound webhook delivery fetches the user-configured subscriberUrl with no egress host/IP allow-list (only redirect:'manual'), enabling SSRF to internal services or cloud metadata.
Server fetch to Microsoft OAuth token endpoint during Outlook calendar token exchange.
demotionReason: Fetch target is a hardcoded Microsoft login host (login.microsoftonline.com); the host is not attacker-controllable.

description: License-check service issues an outbound fetch to the configured license key URL.
demotionReason: Base URL comes from server config (api.licenseKeyUrl); only a trusted licenseKey path segment varies, so the host is not attacker-controlled.

description: Conferencing service fetches the Microsoft Graph 'me' endpoint to resolve the connected account.
demotionReason: Request URL targets a hardcoded Microsoft Graph host (graph.microsoft.com); not influenced by request input.

description: Vercel webhook controller posts to the trigger.dev deployment promote endpoint.
demotionReason: URL host is hardcoded (api.trigger.dev) and only a server-derived version path segment varies; not attacker-controlled.

description: Caught error is written to the application log inside the v1 error capture helper.
demotionReason: Logs a caught Error object through the structured logger; no raw attacker newline reaches the log, so impact is limited to log forging.

description: Booking service logs an error message that interpolates booking.uid via a template literal.
demotionReason: booking.uid is a server-generated CUID, not free-form user text, and the structured logger encodes fields; no injectable newline.

description: HTTP exception filter logs the exception message via the NestJS logger.
demotionReason: Output is emitted through a structured logger and never crosses into a downstream trust boundary; impact limited to log forging.

description: Calendar processor logs a failure message interpolating a userId.
demotionReason: userId is a server-side numeric identifier and the logger structures output; no attacker-controlled control characters are injectable.

description: API key gate reads req.query.apiKey to decide request authentication.
demotionReason: req.query.apiKey is the credential itself; it is hashed and looked up against the ApiKey table, so a missing/invalid value cannot bypass auth.

description: Provided apiKey string is stripped of its prefix before verification.
demotionReason: The stripped value is sha256-hashed and matched in the DB; the raw input grants no access without a valid hash match.

description: Rate-limit helper checks presence of req.query.apiKey before limiting.
demotionReason: Presence check only selects a rate-limit identifier; actual authorization is enforced later by hashed apiKey verification.

description: Math.random()-derived string used when generating a team identifier in the team-create route.
demotionReason: Output is only a fallback teamName/teamSlug (a non-secret display identifier); no token, key, or password is derived from Math.random.

description: Math.random() used to build a React list key in an insights stats table.
demotionReason: Used solely as a React list key for rendering; never a security-sensitive value.

description: Math.random() drives skeleton bar heights in a routing funnel loading state.
demotionReason: Purely cosmetic CSS height for a loading skeleton; no security impact.

description: Double cast 'as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue' coerces a credential key for a Prisma write.
demotionReason: The double cast only types a decrypted JSON credential for Prisma; the runtime value is validated by the upstream credential-sync schema.

description: req.query is cast to 'any' before being passed to a tRPC publish caller.
demotionReason: The tRPC caller re-validates the input against its own Zod schema, so the 'as any' cast does not reach a sink unchecked.

description: Decrypted credential key coerced via double cast for a Prisma JSON column on credential create.
demotionReason: Value originates from a server-decrypted credential store and is shaped by the request validation schema before the typed write.

description: Password-reset request route is exposed via defaultResponderForAppDir with no session guard.
demotionReason: Endpoint is intentionally public (password reset request); it is rate-limited and does not disclose account existence.

description: OAuth 'me' identity route handler is exported without an outer route guard.
demotionReason: Handler validates the OAuth access token internally before returning any identity data.

description: OAuth 'me' route also exposes a POST handler without an outer guard wrapper.
demotionReason: POST handler performs the same internal OAuth token validation before processing, so authorization is enforced in-handler.

description: Team profile renders member.bio through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
demotionReason: member.bio is passed through the markdownToSafeHTML sanitizer before injection, stripping active content.

description: App slug view injects source.content as HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
demotionReason: Rendered HTML is sanitized by markdownToSafeHTML (allow-list) before being injected.

description: Event-type description component assigns descriptionAsSafeHTML to dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
demotionReason: descriptionAsSafeHTML is pre-sanitized server-side; the component name encodes the sanitized invariant and no raw user HTML is injected.

description: PageWrapper injects an inline script setting window.CalComPageStatus from a template literal.
demotionReason: pageStatus is a server-set enum value (e.g. ENABLED), not user input, so the interpolated script content is not attacker-controlled.

description: Template-literal log statement interpolates a runtime value; reviewed as the nearest format-string analog for the format-string category.
demotionReason: JS/TS has no C-style printf format-string sink and template literals are not format strings; the category is structurally inapplicable to this TypeScript codebase (nearest analog is log interpolation, CWE-117).

description: Booking create handler spreads ...req.body into the booking input object.
demotionReason: The request body is parsed and normalized by the Zod booking schema before the spread, so unknown/privileged keys are stripped.

description: Booking delete handler spreads ...req.query into handler arguments.
demotionReason: Query is spread into a typed argument; the downstream Prisma call maps explicit fields rather than spreading raw input into a writable model.

description: Object.assign merges fields onto a cloned booking request in the v2 bookings controller.
demotionReason: The assigned keys (userId, oAuthParams, platformBookingLocation) are server-derived, not attacker-supplied property names, so no privileged property is injected.

description: Script writes generated secrets to a file via fs.writeFileSync.
demotionReason: Build/dev-time secret-generation script with a hardcoded output path; not reachable from any runtime request flow.

description: Swagger generation writes the docs output file via fs.writeFileSync.
demotionReason: Build-time OpenAPI generation with a hardcoded docs output path; not attacker-reachable at runtime.

description: reserveSlot handler issues a Set-Cookie serializing a slot reservation 'uid'.
demotionReason: This is a non-auth slot-reservation cookie; the session/auth cookie is managed separately by next-auth with HttpOnly and Secure set.

description: Client sets a timezone-dialog flag via document.cookie.
demotionReason: Non-sensitive UI preference cookie (timezone dialog dismissal flag); carries no session or auth material.

description: Client writes a locale preference through document.cookie.
demotionReason: Locale preference cookie only; non-sensitive and contains no authentication data.

description: Attendee GET reads prisma.attendee.findUnique({where:{id}}) using a path id.
demotionReason: Preceded by attendees/[id]/_auth-middleware ownership check (findFirst where booking.userId===requester) that throws 403 when the attendee is not owned.

description: Booking GET fetches prisma.booking.findUnique by id from the request path.
demotionReason: bookings/[id]/_auth-middleware verifies the requester is host, attendee, or org-admin (user.bookings + getAccessibleUsers) before the handler runs.

description: API key delete runs prisma.apiKey.delete({where:{id}}) on a path-supplied id.
demotionReason: api-keys/[id]/_auth-middleware scopes the lookup to where:{id,userId}; a non-owner receives 404 before the delete executes.

description: Event-type GET fetches prisma.eventType.findUnique({where:{id}}) by path id.
demotionReason: checkPermissions enforces eventType.userId===req.userId (or validated team membership) before the event type is returned.

description: Membership auth middleware queries prisma.membership.findFirst({where:{userId,teamId}}).
demotionReason: This query is itself the tenant-scoping guard (where:{userId,teamId}); it enforces team membership before downstream access.

description: Transcript route reads prisma.booking.findUnique({where:{id:bookingId}}) for a recording lookup.
demotionReason: Route index.ts invokes the parent bookings/[id] _auth-middleware (host/attendee/admin ownership) before the handler, and the recording is also validated to belong to that booking.

description: Raw $queryRaw selects a Booking row by uid with FOR UPDATE during seat creation.
demotionReason: Parameterized Prisma $queryRaw tagged template binds ${input.bookingUid} as a query parameter (no string concatenation), preventing query tampering/over-disclosure.

description: Booking repository runs a $queryRaw aggregate computing total booking time.
demotionReason: Tagged-template query binds all inputs as parameters and selects only an aggregate scoped by those bound values; no raw interpolation.

description: Swagger script checks fs.existsSync(docsOutputFile) before unlinking/writing it.
demotionReason: Build-time single-process script; no concurrent attacker exists between the existence check and the file use.

description: Static-copy script checks fs.existsSync(destDir) before creating it.
demotionReason: Build script running in a trusted environment; the check-then-create directory step has no security-relevant runtime race.

description: App-store CLI build checks fs.existsSync(configPath) prior to reading config.
demotionReason: CLI build-time file check in a trusted dev/build context; no exploitable check-to-use race window.

description: verifyApiKey resolves { isAdmin, scope } from isAdminGuard to gate admin scope.
demotionReason: This line is the authorization/scope check itself (isAdminGuard); it is a protective control rather than an unguarded sink.

description: Snaplet transform references accessToken while anonymizing seed data.
demotionReason: Occurs in the snaplet data-transform (database seeding/anonymization tooling), not on any runtime authorization path.

description: Snaplet transform references refreshToken during seed anonymization.
demotionReason: Part of seed-data anonymization tooling, executed offline; not a runtime OAuth scope decision.

description: docker-start script invokes execSync('docker compose up -d').
demotionReason: Hardcoded command in a dev startup script with no user input; build/dev-time only (Directive 3 build-time suppression applies).

description: Swagger generator calls spawnSync('node', [biomeBin, 'format', ...]).
demotionReason: spawnSync uses a fixed argv array (no shell) with hardcoded arguments; build-time only and not reachable from request input.

description: Sentry release script runs execSync(`sentry-cli releases new ${release}`).
demotionReason: release is derived from 'git rev-parse HEAD' in trusted CI (not user input); a build/release-time script outside the runtime trust boundary.

description: safeParseJSON helper calls JSON.parse(str) on an input string.
demotionReason: JSON.parse in Node instantiates only plain JSON values (no code execution / object reconstruction); the wrapper additionally catches parse errors.

description: Throttler guard does rateLimitsSchema.parse(JSON.parse(cachedRateLimits)).
demotionReason: The parsed object is immediately validated by the Zod rateLimitsSchema, and the source is a server-written Redis cache value.

description: Calendars controller runs JSON.parse(state) on the OAuth callback state.
demotionReason: OAuth state is server-generated and round-tripped; JSON.parse yields plain data (no type instantiation) and fields are consumed as strings.

description: Apple calendar service runs JSON.parse on a decrypted credential key.
demotionReason: Input is decrypted from the server-encrypted credential store (trusted); JSON.parse yields plain data with no code execution.

description: Editor toolbar plugin constructs a DOMParser to parse markup client-side.
demotionReason: Browser DOMParser does not resolve external entities or DTDs (no XXE); it runs client-side on editor content only.

description: A second DOMParser instance is created in the editor toolbar plugin.
demotionReason: Same client-side browser DOMParser, which ignores external entities; there is no server-side XML entity expansion.

description: Outbound webhook HMAC (X-Cal-Signature-256) is silently dropped when secretKey is null: createWebhookSignature returns '' so subscribers receive unsigned, unauthenticatable payloads.
demotionReason: Broken mitigation: HMAC signing exists but the empty-secret fallback (createWebhookSignature returns '') bypasses it, so any consumer relying on signature verification will accept forged or replayed webhooks.
